name: FIELDWORK
description: A fictional landscape studio concept. Original generated courtyard imagery.

sections.title: A little closer to outside.
sections.body: A garden should feel like part of your home. This studio concept brings practical spaces, generous planting and a calmer pace to everyday life.

image.alt: Generated concept courtyard with olive tree, limestone steps, sage planting and a timber bench.

sections.eyebrow: From first sketch to final planting
sections.title: Room for the way you live.

items.label: 01 / Imagine
items.title: Garden design
items.body: A clear layout, planting direction and material palette shaped around how you want to use your space.

items.label: 02 / Shape
items.title: Outdoor spaces
items.body: Courtyards, paths and places to gather. Establish the useful structure before choosing the finishing touches.

items.label: 03 / Grow
items.title: Planting plans
items.body: Plant choices considered against light, soil, water and the care your garden will need over time.

sections.title: Good gardens start with good questions.
sections.body: The courtyard shown is a generated design concept, not a completed client project. A live site would replace this block with verified work, credentials and service-area details.

facts.label: First conversation
facts.value: How will you use the space?

sections.title: What would you like to grow?
sections.body: Tell the studio about your location, the space and your priorities. This demonstration uses an example email address; connect the client’s real booking or inquiry destination before launch.
